title: Q21: why the slow ISP wins, and the fix
description: Two ISPs both advertise 8.8.8.0/24. The fast one (r2) was set to LocPref 50, so the slow one (r3, default 100) wins. Raise r2 to LocPref 150, then drop the r1-r2 link and bring it back.

scenes.title: The slow ISP r3 is best
scenes.caption: 8.8.8.0/24 is heard from both ISPs. r2 (fast) has LocPref 50, so r3 (slow, 100) wins. Why the slow one?

scenes.title: LocPref 150 on r2: the fast ISP wins
scenes.caption: Raise LocPref to 150 on r2. The fast ISP is best again (150 > 100).

scenes.title: r1-r2 link down: only r3 is left
scenes.caption: With the r1-r2 link down, 8.8.8.0/24 has one path, via r3.

scenes.title: Link back: LocPref decides again
scenes.caption: The link is back. LocPref 150 > 100 decides again: the fast ISP r2 wins.
